mapper.select: SELECT i.PST_ID, i.ATHR_ID, i.PST_CTGRY, i.PST_NM, i.PST_CNTNT, i.LST_MOD_DT, i.IS_DLT, i.DLT_DT, i.PST_HT, i.IS_PST_OPN, m.MBR_NM FROM IB_PST i JOIN MBR_INFO m ON i.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR WHERE i.IS_DLT = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.PST_CTGRY = 0 THEN 1 END, i.LST_MOD_DT DESC

SELECT i.PST_ID, i.ATHR_ID, i.PST_CTGRY, i.PST_NM, i.PST_CNTNT, i.LST_MOD_DT, i.IS_DLT, i.DLT_DT, i.PST_HT, i.IS_PST_OPN, m.MBR_NM FROM IB_PST i JOIN MBR_INFO m ON i.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR WHERE PST_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IB_PST ( PST_ID , ATHR_ID , PST_CTGRY , PST_NM , PST_CNTNT , LST_MOD_DT , IS_DLT , DLT_DT , PST_HT , IS_PST_OPN) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('IB_PST_PK_SEQ') , #{athrId} , #{pstCtgry} , #{pstNm} , #{pstCntnt} , NOW() , 0 , NULL , 0 , #{isPstOpn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE IB_PST SET IS_DLT = '1' , DLT_DT = NOW() WHERE PST_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS LV , i.CMMNT_ID , i.PST_ID , i.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , i.LST_MOD_DT , i.CMMNT_CNTNT , i.IS_DLT , i.DLT_DT , i.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , ARRAY[LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.LST_MOD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0')] AS sort_path FROM IB_CNT i INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON i.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR WHERE i.PST_ID = #{_parameter} AND i.PRNT_CMMNT_ID IS NULL AND i.IS_DLT = '0' UNION ALL SELECT cte.LV + 1 , i.CMMNT_ID , i.PST_ID , i.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , i.LST_MOD_DT , i.CMMNT_CNTNT , i.IS_DLT , i.DLT_DT , i.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , cte.sort_path || LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM i.LST_MOD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0') FROM IB_CNT i INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON i.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR INNER JOIN cte ON i.PRNT_CMMNT_ID = cte.CMMNT_ID ) SELECT LV, CMMNT_ID, PST_ID, PRNT_CMMNT_ID, LST_MOD_DT, CMMNT_CNTNT, IS_DLT, DLT_DT, ATHR_ID, MBR_NM FROM cte ORDER BY sort_path ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IB_CNT ( CMMNT_ID , PST_ID , PRNT_CMMNT_ID , LST_MOD_DT , CMMNT_CNTNT , IS_DLT , DLT_DT , ATHR_ID ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('IB_CNT_PK_SEQ') , #{pstId} , #{prntCmmntId} , NOW() , #{cmmntCntnt} , 0 , NULL , #{athrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE IB_CNT SET IS_DLT = 1 , DLT_DT = NOW() WHERE CMMNT_ID = #{_parameter}
